text: Improve your understanding by acquiring useful knowledge and virtue, such as will render you an ornament to society, an honor to your country, and a blessing to your parents. Great learning and superior abilities, should you ever possess them, will be of little value and small estimation, unless virtue, honor, truth, and integrity are added to them.
author: Abigail Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 232, Abigail Adams to John Quincy Adams
